summary: SKBike OFFLINE mode end-to-end frontend verification on Expo web preview (375x667). Zero backend calls, all sales persisted via localStorage fallback (key 'skbike_sales'). Full flow PASSED: PIN 8193 unlock -> letter keypad YVK correctly derives HARGA MODAL Rp 1.350.000 (letter mapping P0 Y1 F2 V3 H4 K5 T6 B7 R8 Q9 verified via 3 codes) -> CHECK HARGA JUAL -> Barang Terjual -> sell form (Foto tiles 'Galeri'+'Kamera' render without crash) -> fill Nama Barang + Nama Pembeli -> SIMPAN PENJUALAN -> lands on History with new card at top, TRANSAKSI=1, TOTAL OMZET=Rp 1.350.000. Multiple sales test: created 3 sales (YVK=1.350.000, PYF=120.000, HTB=4.670.000) -> summary correctly shows TRANSAKSI=3, TOTAL OMZET=Rp 6.140.000 (1.350k+120k+4.670k). History search: typing 'TEST_Buyer_B' filters to 1 card, typing 'TEST_Sepeda_A' also filters to 1 card, X clear restores all 3. Date filters: 'Hari ini'/'Semua tanggal'/'Minggu ini'/'Bulan ini' chips all clickable and filter the list; 'Pilih tanggal' opens DatePickerModal (verified 'Batal' present in DOM). Detail page: tap card -> detail-hero shows 'TEST_Sepeda_C | STATUS BELUM DIATUR | HARGA JUAL | Rp 4.670.000'. Edit flow: pencil (detail-edit-button) -> title 'Edit Penjualan' with input-pembeli prefilled 'TEST_Buyer_C' and margin '0' -> changed pembeli to 'TEST_Buyer_C_Edited' + margin '50000' -> SIMPAN PERUBAHAN -> returned to detail, both '_Edited' and 'Rp 50.000' present. Delete from detail: confirm modal 'Hapus Penjualan?' -> confirm-delete -> card count 3->2. Delete from history trash: single-tap -> card count 2->1 (data persists in localStorage after each op). CRITICAL OFFLINE CHECK: 0 /api/ requests captured during the entire session; localStorage['skbike_sales'] populated (435 bytes after final state). Only non-blocking react-native-web deprecation warnings: 'shadow*' style props, 'props.pointerEvents', and 'useNativeDriver not supported' (web-only). No red screen, no page errors, no failed network requests.

react_native_issues.issue: Non-blocking web deprecations: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' and 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported' — all originate from libraries / web-only fallbacks, no functional impact.
